identity.notes: A boutique gated community of 15 luxury modern single-family homes in Delray Beach, FL 33446, developed by The Spear Group. Adjacent to Morikami Park, homes span 3,600–5,050 sq ft and are priced from $2.7 million. The community emphasizes privacy, serenity, and proximity to nature, blending Eastern design principles with Western details. No shared recreational amenities (pool, clubhouse, fitness center) exist; residents have private pools as a home option.
